question: Does adversity-before-opportunity path ordering distinguish V1 extreme winners from false breakouts beyond excursion magnitude and frozen path mechanics?
mechanism: Durable demand may absorb early adverse movement before later expansion to MFE, whereas failed breakouts may realize their limited opportunity before later deterioration to MAE.
prediction: Normalized days-to-MFE minus days-to-MAE is positively associated with extreme winners and negatively associated with false breakouts after fixed magnitude, duration, entry-state, year, and exit controls.
interpretation_boundary: The feature uses the completed held path and is conditioned on the frozen exit mechanism. It is descriptive path topology, unavailable at entry, and cannot establish a causal or deployable rule.

sample.eligibility: complete accepted MFE, MAE, days-to-MFE, days-to-MAE, holding duration, terminal return, and exit lineage
sample.missingness: fail closed; no imputation, post-exit extension, coordinate substitution, or replay

path_semantics.coordinates: zero-based offsets over entry-execution through exit-execution inclusive
path_semantics.tie_rule: accepted Phase 1 Python max/min over chronological tuples returns the first occurrence; same-session MFE/MAE has primary value zero

multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg over exactly the two primary raw endpoint p-values

gates_per_endpoint.raw: oriented rho >= 0.15, positive within-year rank rho, >=7/8 positive LOYO, and BH q <= 0.05
gates_per_endpoint.controlled: oriented partial-rank rho >= 0.10 with >=7/8 positive controlled LOYO
gates_per_endpoint.neighbors: both unscaled-day and signed-order oriented rhos positive with >=6/8 positive LOYO
gates_per_endpoint.falsification: oriented ex-global-Top-4 P&L, holding>=5, and ex-opposite-tail rhos each >=0.05; >=80% positive leave-one-security and leave-one-industry omissions; >=2/3 positive baseline blocks

decision.DEEPEN: both endpoints pass all four gates
decision.REFINE: exactly one endpoint passes all four gates
decision.PIVOT: at least one endpoint passes raw and controlled gates but fails neighbor or falsification
decision.REJECT: no endpoint passes both raw and controlled gates

falsification: integer coordinates within each accepted held path
within-year ranks, per-year estimates, and eight LOYO omissions
MFE, adverse-excursion magnitude, and holding-duration controls
fixed V1 entry, market, breadth, beta, volatility, and liquidity controls
canonical exit reason and entry-year controls
global Top-4 realized-PnL removal and opposite-tail removal
zero post-exit rows, replays, counterfactual paths, or strategy rules
forbidden: calling completed-path order an entry predictor or actionable state
testing any entry, hold, exit, stop, ranking, sizing, or production change
changing endpoint, orientation, normalization, neighbor, control, or gate after results
adding path-order variants to rescue a failed primary
breadth historical redesign or invalid Phase 7/8/9 use
